# Flower City AI

Independent consultancy based in Brampton, Ontario, serving small businesses in Brampton and Peel.

Services include an AI Opportunity Audit, hands-on team training, customer-reply guides and follow-ups, and small admin workflows. An audit reviews up to three tasks and provides a prioritized plan, worked example and readout. Funding screening helps identify possible routes, subject to program and provider rules. Each service is scoped and priced before work begins.

- [Website](https://flowercityai.ca/)
- [Fictional sample audit](https://flowercityai.ca/sample-audit.html)
- [Funding approach and dated sources](https://flowercityai.ca/funding.html)
- [Privacy](https://flowercityai.ca/privacy.html)

Examples are illustrative, not measured client results. Funding is conditional on program, customer, provider and project eligibility. The commercial audit is not automatically an approved DMAP. No funding or savings guarantee is made.
